question: How many unique customers have placed orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM customers;

question: How many customers are there in each state?
sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

question: Which customer states have the most orders?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the total amount spent by customers in each state?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: What is the average order value for each customer state?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(order_totals.order_value), 2) AS average_order_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_value FROM payments GROUP BY order_id) order_totals ON o.order_id = order_totals.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;
